subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Institute of Clockwork Applications
Enter the Institute of Clockwork Applications

740880401.text: #There should be a Survey Anchor here too. I'll open the door, and leave the recovery to you, {NICKNAME}.

740880601.text: Yeah... I still can't forget how Choiseul just kept equivocating.

740880602.text: And that Raimondo... So haughty and arrogant. Did you see how he was looking at me?

740880603.text: I think you're much better than either of those two. Things would have never turned out like that if you were in their position.

740880501.text: I believe this place was originally Butor's "Institute of Clockwork Applications." In the field of clockwork machines, Monsieur Butor was one of the leading authorities.

740880502.text: However, scientifically, the development and advancement of traditional clockwork machines had reached a bottleneck. In terms of applications, traditional clockwork machines were obviously at a great disadvantage.

740880503.text: Anyway, Monsieur Butor's program was slowly being marginalized at the Institute. His funding was cut, and he struggled to recruit researchers.

740880504.text: After a series of unfortunate incidents, Monsieur Butor's group finally disbanded, and this facility was completely abandoned.

740880505.text: *sigh* Monsieur Butor was terribly unlucky, if you ask me...
